sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate faithfully applies the direct calculation only to ships having an ice-strengthened hull structure, keeps all properties on their authoritative owners, uses the required operands and result, and correctly encodes the less-than comparison with the 0.0005 m threshold.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: The shape incorrectly applies the thickness and renewal constraints to every ship, omitting the requirement’s ice-strengthened-structure applicability. Keep ship as the target owner, but select or gate applicable ships through nltl:hasComponent to an nltl:hullStructure whose nltl:iceStrengthenedStructureStatus is true; place that status only on the hull-structure node. Ensure the mandatory operands, result, and comparison execute only for that applicable branch. Do not add the status directly to the ship or simply require every ship to be ice strengthened. The existing 0.0005 m threshold and less-than implication are otherwise directionally correct.

The candidate faithfully applies the direct calculation only to ships having an ice-strengthened hull structure, keeps all properties on their authoritative owners, uses the required operands and result, and correctly encodes the less-than comparison with the 0.0005 m threshold.
